result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues where content cards are being cut off due to overflow problems, making text unreadable and cards incomplete.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section has truncated text - 'Trattoria Piccol' appears to be cut off at the right edge, likely missing characters from the restaurant name
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scrolling container or card container has proper sizing and text truncation handling. Either allow full text display or implement proper text truncation with ellipsis (...)

issues.description: The bottom card in 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off vertically, showing only the top portion of a pizza image and preventing users from seeing the full card details
issues.suggestion: Adjust the vertical spacing, container height, or implement proper scrolling/pagination to ensure all cards are fully visible or properly scrollable without being cut off at the bottom
